can_do_vi: Nói về các phát minh quan trọng
Dự đoán cuộc sống trong tương lai với "will" và "might"
grammar_note_vi: Dự đoán chắc chắn dùng "will": "People will use more robots." Không chắc chắn dùng "might" (có thể): "We might have flying cars."

My uncle has a smart TV.
In the future, people will|Robots might|The greatest invention is

text_en: What will schools be like in the future?
Some people think that students might not go to school at all.
They might learn at home with virtual reality headsets.
With virtual reality, students could visit ancient Egypt or walk on Mars during a history or science lesson.
Artificial intelligence might help each student learn at their own speed.
Robots might help teachers in the classroom.
However, many people believe that schools will still be important.
Students need to meet their friends, play together and learn teamwork.
In my opinion, technology will make schools better, but it will never replace good teachers.
